ayahOccurrences.text: وَلَا تُصَعِّرْ خَدَّكَ لِلنَّاسِ وَلَا تَمْشِ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَرَحًا ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍ فَخُورٍ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَلَا تُصَعِّرْ خَدَّكَ لِلنَّاسِ وَلَا تَمْشِ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَرَحًا ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍ فَخُورٍ

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 2nd person masculine singular (form II) imperfect verb, jussive mood
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: تُصَعِّرْ is in the derivative form: تُصَعِّر
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ص/ع/ر   ṣ–ʿ–r (in camels) a disease that causes a distortion and twisting of the neck to 1 side; to turn away one’s cheek from people out of contempt arising from pride. Of this root, 1 form, تُصَعِّر tuṣaʿʿir, occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
تُصَعِّر tuṣaʿʿir [imperf. of v. II, trans.] to turn the cheek away, or toward, in pride

(31:18) وَلاَ تُصَعِّرْ خَدَّكَ لِلنَّاسِ do not arrogantly turn your cheek toward/away from people.
